story_overview: Leo researches historical documents, starting on a city bus and continuing in an old stone chapel where he confers with Clara and Daniel. As Leo uncovers a shocking detail, Isabelle and Casey separately examine an antique French letter and a map of Normandy, discovering a key location. The story concludes with Leo recounting these events in an interview.
